records.source: Public because a host that owns this editor inside a larger screen can call it directly — Qt delivers a close event to the window, not to every widget inside it, so a screen that wants pending results discarded when the user navigates away must call it. Slow database reads can continue in parked workers without delivering their results to this editor. Idempotent.
records.context: Public because a host that owns this editor inside a larger application view can call it directly — Qt delivers a close event to the window, not to every widget inside it, so an application view that wants pending results discarded when the user navigates away must call it. Slow database reads can continue in parked workers without delivering their results to this editor. Idempotent.
records.translation: Es público para que el contenedor que posee este editor dentro de una pantalla mayor pueda llamarlo directamente: Qt entrega el evento de cierre a la ventana, no a cada widget que contiene. Por ello, una pantalla que quiera descartar resultados pendientes cuando el usuario se aleja debe llamarlo. Las lecturas lentas de la base de datos pueden continuar en hilos de trabajo aparcados sin entregar sus resultados a este editor. Es idempotente.
